title: Automating Transparency Mechanisms in the Judicial System Using LLMs: Opportunities and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM accuracy in extracting juror gender composition from court transcripts and simulating a downstream audit by calculating female-to-male juror selection ratios to measure how LLM extraction errors alter the conclusions of a bias audit.

Evaluating the LLM's ability to accurately identify Batson challenges (legal objections to discriminatory juror strikes based on race, ethnicity, or sex) from unstructured criminal trial court transcripts.

Assessing LLM performance in extracting key eviction case variables (e.g., landlord representation status, settlement types, and execution issuances) from court records to enable automated audits of systemic power imbalances and exploitative practices in housing courts.
